sources.title: Online undergraduate admission requirements
sources.quote: Students must have a 2.0 or above cumulative GPA for admission in good standing.

sources.title: Residential undergraduate admission requirements
sources.quote: Applications are reviewed on a case-by-case basis, meaning there is no set minimum GPA required for admission as an undergraduate student.

sources.title: 2026–2027 online academic policies
sources.quote: Regular attendance in online courses is expected throughout the length of the term.

sources.title: 2026–2027 residential academic policies
sources.quote: In general, regular and punctual attendance in all classes is expected of all students.

sources.title: 2026–2027 Human Services course requirements
sources.quote: students will participate in a bi-weekly synchronous seminar as well as direct service opportunities in their community.

sources.title: 2026–2027 Psychology course requirements
sources.quote: Senior or Junior Status, 18 credits of PSYC coursework successfully completed

sources.title: Online BS in Psychology program information
sources.quote: A Bachelor of Science in Psychology is a non-licensure program.

sources.title: Human Services major professional preparation
sources.quote: it is recommended that the student pursue a graduate degree and obtain appropriate licensure.

facts.label: 2.0 GPA for good standing
facts.detail: Liberty’s general online undergraduate admission policy specifies a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 for admission in good standing. This is not an automatic admission decision.

facts.label: Education records for admission
facts.detail: Official high school or GED records are generally required; qualifying college credits or an associate degree can change that requirement. Unofficial college transcripts with a Transcript Request Form can support initial acceptance; official records are still required.

facts.label: Participation starts in the first week
facts.detail: Online courses require academic participation during the first week of the subterm, such as submitting a graded assignment. Students who do not begin participation can be dropped. This is different from a required live class meeting.

facts.label: Applications reviewed individually
facts.detail: Liberty’s residential undergraduate admissions page states that applications are considered individually, without a fixed minimum admission GPA. This differs from the online good-standing policy.

facts.label: Transcripts and Champion Story
facts.detail: Residential applicants submit the admission application, applicable education transcripts and a Champion Story. Transfer applicants with an associate degree do not need high school transcripts. Additional documents can be requested individually.

facts.label: Regular class attendance
facts.detail: Liberty’s residential attendance policy expects regular, punctual class attendance throughout the term. Course schedules and the attendance policy govern the campus portion of this plan.

facts.label: Live capstone seminars
facts.detail: The proposed Human Services route uses HSER 497. This capstone includes live seminars every other week.

facts.label: Community experience required
facts.detail: HSER 497 includes direct-service experience in the student’s community, even though the degree is an online program.

facts.label: Apply before taking the capstone
facts.detail: HSER 497 requires senior standing in the Human Services major, at least a 2.0 overall GPA, its listed prerequisite courses and department approval. Apply for that approval in the preceding semester.

facts.label: Further study for advanced counseling
facts.detail: For advanced practice such as mental health counseling or therapy, Liberty recommends graduate study and appropriate licensure. The bachelor’s degree alone is not a state-specific licensing determination.

facts.label: Psychology capstone prerequisites
facts.detail: The proposed route selects PSYC 491. Registration requires junior or senior standing, 18 completed PSYC credits, and the listed introductory and research prerequisites with their required grades.

facts.label: Capstone instead of an internship
facts.detail: The proposed route uses PSYC 491 as an alternative to the internship. Its course description includes observing clinical work through online meetings and recorded counseling sessions.

facts.label: Non-licensure psychology degree
facts.detail: Liberty explicitly describes the general online BS in Psychology as a non-licensure program. A bachelor’s degree alone does not qualify someone to practice as a psychologist.
